change: turn order at all-way stops for the driven car and traffic; left turns at stop signs yield to oncoming traffic; production audits include both rules
before: main at 4119e8712bbd767f045cbb372390d076abec7ca9 in a separate git worktree

method.v8: scripts/bench_node.mjs; Node v24.19.0; V8 13.6.233.17-node.51, identical before and after
method.servers: Each checkout ran its own python3 server.py (stdlib fallback); after on port 8331, before on port 8332; HTTP readiness checked before running suites
method.execution: One suite at a time, each checkout using its own scripts/bench_node.mjs and server. Node 24 uses built-in module detection; --experimental-default-type=module was omitted because this version rejects it.
method.scope: V8 only. WebKit was not run: scripts/shot.swift is macOS-only and this environment is Linux. Night was not run.
method.audits: Each checkout used its own production audits; the after checkout additionally audits all-way turn order and oncoming traffic on left turns at stop signs.

post_fix.change: Bound incomplete-stop deadlock waits to the line clearing distance; use manual turn indicators when no route turn is available.

method.v8: scripts/bench_node.mjs; Node v24.19.0; V8 13.6.233.17-node.51, matching the cloud runs above
method.platform: macOS 27.0.1 (26A434), arm64; original before/after cloud runs above used Linux
method.server: PORT=8331 uv run --locked server.py; HTTP readiness checked
method.execution: One benchmark suite at a time; all 15 suites rerun. npx --yes --package=node@24.19.0 node scripts/bench_node.mjs --port 8331 --map MAP --count COUNT --weather WEATHER --json OUT.json
method.scope: V8 only; WebKit and night were not run.
method.comparison: All rounded per-route metrics and event types/times match the initial after run above, apart from Toronto dry s1-2. Victoria s1-2 has sub-1e-12 differences in the first safety event raw gap and closing speed. Wall times differ. Original before/after values are preserved unchanged.

method.harness: Unmodified scripts/shot.swift compiled with swiftc; a fresh WKWebView process for each suite; one benchmark suite at a time.
method.before: git archive 4119e87 extracted to a temporary checkout; its own server.py on port 8332
method.after: Current PR checkout at the after_commit above; its own server.py on port 8331
method.servers: Both used the current checkout .venv/bin/python3; HTTP readiness checked before suites
method.execution: Each /bench?map=PRESET waits for map readiness, then runs window.__bench.run({brain: "rules", count: COUNT, npcs: 40, seed: 1, mode: "lockstep", weather: WEATHER, save: false}); the returned config, summary and results are preserved here.
method.scope: 70 routes before and 70 after, across 15 suites per side; night was not run.
method.baseline_check: Every before summary exactly reproduces the previous WebKit after summary in rebaseline-2026-10-22b-rules.json.
